criterion: Recursively traverses nested dicts in diff_snapshots(before, after) emitting ChangeEntry records with dot-separated paths (e.g. 'db.pool.max_size') sorted by path.
Implements apply_diff(base, changes) and revert_diff(target, changes) in statecfg/differ.py without mutating the input dictionaries.
Cleanly handles added, modified, and removed nested keys when applying and reverting patches.
Adds unit tests under tests/ verifying nested dot-path generation, round-trip apply_diff/revert_diff equivalence, and input immutability.
All unit tests in tests/ pass when executed with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
